page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at top with the page number at top right. No marginal notes. Below the text: a gathering signature at left and a catchword at right.

main_text.p: Hos.2.8. Etipsa nesciebat, quòd ego dedissem ei frumentum & vinum & oleum: immò argentum quod ei multiplicaueram, & aurum fecerunt in Baal. 9.Idcirco conuertar, & sumam frumenti meum tempore suo, & vinum meum temporefuo: auferamq; lanam meam & linū meum, quae dederam ad tegendam ignominiam eius.
1.Tim.6.7.Nihil in mudum intissimus[?], uidelicet nec efferre quicquam possumus.
§. Sed habentes alimenta, & quibus tegamur, his contenti sumus.
main_text.head: THESIS SECVNDA.
main_text.p: Bruta animatia, plantae, & ea quae è terra nascuntur, Dei prouidentiae non funte-ximenda[?], & cum aliquid agunt, & cum patiuntur.
Ita rem habere, inductione adhibita ostendemus.

1. Ortus & conseruatio specierum statuum omnium non nisi Deo accepta ferri debent. Gen.1. Et Psal.36.7. Hominem & animal feruas Iehouah. Psal.104.14. Deus germinare facit fœnum pro iumentis, herbam ad usum hominum, ut educat panem e terra.

page.notes: Running head and page number read as printed. "temporefuo" is printed without a space. "intissimus" is hard to read and is marked [?]. "funte-ximenda" is uncertain and marked [?]. "mudum" is printed as "mudum". The catchword is "Orna-" with a printed "2." before it, which I read as part of the signature line; it is not in the catchword. The thesis numbers and the verse references in the text are kept as printed.
